unterlinden.name: Isenheim Altarpiece
unterlinden.slogan: A crucified Christ that Colmar still can't look away from.
unterlinden.line: Painted by Grünewald between 1512 and 1516 for the Antonite hospital chapel in Isenheim, it now hangs in Colmar's Unterlinden Museum.

petitevenise.name: Petite Venise
petitevenise.slogan: Pastel gables and flat boats along the Lauch.
petitevenise.line: Colmar's fishermen belonged to a powerful guild and kept live fish in tanks fed by the Lauch beside their quayside houses.

riquewihr.name: Riquewihr
riquewihr.slogan: Riesling cellars behind a ring of sixteenth-century walls.
riquewihr.line: Only about 1,200 people live in Riquewihr, yet some two million visitors come every year.

citeauto.name: Cité de l'Automobile
citeauto.slogan: Hundreds of Bugattis parked like paintings.
citeauto.line: It holds two of the six original Bugatti Royales, plus a replica the Schlumpf brothers built from genuine parts.

eguisheim.name: Eguisheim
eguisheim.slogan: A village wound in rings around its castle.
eguisheim.line: Pope Leo IX was born here as Bruno of Eguisheim-Dagsbourg in 1002, and he became pope in 1049.
